verdict.rationale: Meltano's own docs show it installs locally via pip, runs EL(T) pipelines from its CLI with `meltano run`, and can test plugin configuration with `meltano config test`, so the local run-and-test core is documented. Nothing in the pack shows a lightweight local destination or a dev-versus-production environment separation for promoting pipelines. missing for 10: a documented lightweight local destination (e.g. a file or embedded database loader), documented dev/staging vs production environment switching, end-to-end pipeline testing beyond config tests, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I run and test a pipeline locally against a lightweight destination before it touches production

citations.quote: Meltano is pip-installable and comes in a prepackaged docker container, you can have your first ELT pipeline running within minutes.
You can run EL(T) pipelines using [`meltano run`]
its configuration can be tested using meltano config test <plugin>
benefit from DataOps best practices such as version control, code review, and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)
